results.title: Deep learning uncertainty quantification for enhancing TBM ...
results.content: # Deep learning uncertainty quantification for enhancing TBM operational predictions. Introduces a pioneering framework that integrates deep learning and uncertainty quantification for TBM operational predictions customized to the needs of the underground metaverse. Demonstrates how deep ensembles significantly improve the accuracy of TBM advance speed and geological condition predictions, while also quantifying predictive uncertainties. This paper introduces a methodology utilizing probabilistic DL to quantify prediction uncertainties, offering an alternative to Bayesian Neural Networks through simpler models and effective metrics. Applied to a dataset from an real tunnel project, our approach not only predicts advance speed and geological conditions but also quantifies uncertainties associated with these predictions, enhancing decision-making accuracy. Additionally, our methodology facilitates the quantification of uncertainty and calibration, which leads to a deeper understanding of model confidence and the reliability of its predictions. This study demonstrates the importance of integrating confidence levels into DL applications for tunneling and highlights the enhanced ability to quantify uncertainty and calibrate models effectively. The authors do not have permission to share data.
